payload.label: Refuse a post that shows or names someone without a grant
payload.produces: For each post: allowed true with no one missing a grant, or the run stops with consent refused listing who and how. Deterministic first (media subjects, names, handles and emails matched to people); an AI step only adds suspects, never clears one.

posts.description: Each post: {address, caption, media: [material ids], channel, purpose (default publish)}

credential_name.description: The credential name of that pursuit store

store.description: The pursuit store that holds the grants and material rows the check reads

messages.content: Do the task. Answer with one JSON object only, the fields this JSON schema describes, never the schema itself. {"type":"object","required":["posts"],"properties":{"posts":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["address","people","none_found"],"properties":{"address":{"type":"string"},"people":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["name_or_description","where","evidence"],"properties":{"name_or_description":{"type":"string"},"where":{"type":"string","enum":["caption","media"]},"evidence":{"type":"string"}}}},"none_found":{"type":"boolean"}}}}}}. List every person a post shows or names: a full name, a first name alone, a handle, or a description such as "my coach". For media, list only people the media names in its file name or description; you cannot see pictures. Set none_found to true exactly when people is empty. A name is a person's name: never a single letter, a word of the post's own text, or a label such as a test or draft title. Never decide whether a post may go out.

context.title: Name every person a post may show or name, as a model answer checked by the refuse step

input.sql:
WITH p AS (SELECT x->>'address' AS address, coalesce(x->>'caption', '') AS cap, coalesce(x->>'channel', '') AS ch, coalesce(nullif(x->>'purpose', ''), 'publish') AS pu, coalesce(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(x->'media') = 'array' THEN x->'media' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)), '{}') AS media FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof($1::jsonb) = 'array' THEN $1::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_array($1::jsonb) END) x),
ent AS (SELECT e->>'address' AS address, e->'people' AS people, e->'none_found' AS nf FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(consent_model_answer($2::text)->'posts', '[]'::jsonb)) e),
valid AS (SELECT address, people FROM ent WHERE jsonb_typeof(people) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(nf) = 'boolean' AND (nf = 'true'::jsonb) = (jsonb_array_length(people) = 0)),
s AS (SELECT v.address, ARRAY(SELECT x->>'name_or_description' FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.people) x) AS names FROM valid v)
SELECT p.address,
  (p.address IN (SELECT address FROM valid) AND count(r.refused_subject) = 0) AS allowed,
  CASE WHEN p.address NOT IN (SELECT address FROM valid) THEN 'refused: the model answer for this post is missing or not valid'
       WHEN count(r.refused_subject) > 0 THEN 'refused: someone shown or named here holds no grant for this use' END AS says,
  CASE WHEN p.address NOT IN (SELECT address FROM valid) THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('refused_subject', 'model answer', 'refused_how', 'unusable', 'via', 'model'))
       ELSE coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('refused_subject', r.refused_subject, 'refused_how', r.refused_how, 'via', r.via)) FILTER (WHERE r.refused_subject IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) END AS refused
FROM p LEFT JOIN s ON s.address = p.address
LEFT JOIN LATERAL post_refusals(p.cap, p.media, p.pu, p.ch, coalesce(s.names, '{}')) r ON true
GROUP BY p.address ORDER BY p.address

context.title: Find every person shown or named and check each grant
Stop the post when anyone has no grant

config.error: consent refused: the model that names the people in a post did not answer, so nothing is posted
